text:
"Treat every man you meet the exact same" will get u a crazy amount of mileage, way more than you'd expect...the catch I think, being that u genuinely have to believe it in ur soul.

which very few do, which is exactly why it stands out. Its like that CS Lewis quote below, about how a proud man cannot know God because he's looking down on people

"when you're looking down, you can't see what's above you."

same principle... if you treat the bum on the street different than the CEO, both of them will sense that it isn't real. 

u just can't turn that on and off, and most ppl carry a weighted vest of prejudices with them, the "I'm better than these people" - without realizing that its self-defeating

bc u want to show respect to people of high place, but beyond that, no man is different than u. 

they are all the same, anywhere on earth, and none of them (the good ones at least) demand to be treated as anything more than just another man

I talk about this w/ buddies in small biz, founders, entrepreneurs, where most of the day u are in the minority for having a college degree

and I actually take that back bc I know guys with C-level roles, 1000s of employees under them, where its the same, the majority of their day is spent dealing with humans that grew up very differently than u

u dont even notice if u treat ppl the same, but u see guys sometimes who are educated where ur like...wtf lol, u are so clearly not comfortable, and everyone senses it

absolutely horrible look

guys are always looking for "he thinks hes better than me" and ur dead to them

so in any situation its bad news, but even in business, its hard to be an effective leader if everyone under u thinks ur a joke and a prick

thats how arrogance and prejudice are self-defeating, ur too busy looking down, and so u can never rise

but assuming u do believe it and live it, people are always going to poke and prod from different angles, and test if u really walk the walk...test if u give preferential treatment for one guy, reveal a distaste for another

because ur toast after that, u aint special, ur two-faced, just like the rest of them

there's some Kipling in here too, kings and common men...and if u really do move that way, its gonna come out over time

and for whatever reason -- above me to explain why -- its very very hard, almost impossible, to dislike someone who is the same person at all times, to all men.

and where people know, like, no matter who it is, if they step across ur line, ur gonna knock their head off, no exceptions

so even people who dislike you, that gets shaved down and replaced with a begrudging respect

"I don't like him, but I respect him" - perfectly valid way to feel about somebody else...and if u get all this right, thats the worst someone can say about u.

just one of those eternal laws, CS Lewis puts it very well, but its so deep there is no counter argument.

love ur fellow man, treat him as equal, good things come if u do, bad things come if u dont...u got no need for anyone who either doesn't believe it, or who doesn't live by it.
